_: RxGuard v1.8.3 -- an orexin receptor antagonist and narcolepsy. The previous build is reconstructed as app.py only, and it loads the SAME knowledge files, so a version control can only see the app.py half (the narcolepsy condition). The knowledge-base half is broken on purpose at load time in a copy of app.py, just after the base is read: the entry removed, each family of rules dropped, the sedation score and the hepatic text taken away.

assertions.name: 01 the orexin antagonist is in the knowledge base

mutation.why: the knowledge base does not know the new entry
mutation.replace:
reload_overlay(force=True)
DRUGS.pop([r for r in PAIRWISE if r['id']=='PW025'][0]['a'], None)

assertions.name: 02 strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors are RED

mutation.why: the label's avoid rules for CYP3A inhibitors are gone
mutation.replace:
reload_overlay(force=True)
PAIRWISE[:] = [r for r in PAIRWISE if r['id'] not in ('PW025','PW026','PW027','PW028','PW029','PW030')]

assertions.name: 03 a strong CYP3A inducer is RED

mutation.replace:
reload_overlay(force=True)
PAIRWISE[:] = [r for r in PAIRWISE if r['id'] not in ('PW031','PW031B')]

mutation.why: the new entry carries no sedation score
mutation.replace:
reload_overlay(force=True)
DRUGS[[r for r in PAIRWISE if r['id']=='PW025'][0]['a']]['burden']['sedation'] = 0

mutation.why: the narcolepsy rule is gone though the condition exists
mutation.replace:
reload_overlay(force=True)
CONDITION_RULES[:] = [r for r in CONDITION_RULES if r['id'] != 'CR016']

assertions.name: 06 hepatic impairment carries the label's limits

mutation.replace:
reload_overlay(force=True)
DRUGS[[r for r in PAIRWISE if r['id']=='PW025'][0]['a']].pop('hepatic', None)
